entities.name: Avacyn's Memorial
entities.description: Legendary memorial statue on Innistrad, built by the faithful from wood, straw, twine and clay in honor of Avacyn, indestructible through their faith.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel of Innistrad honored by the memorial.

events.summary: Those faithful to Avacyn build a memorial statue to her following her death.
events.quote: It was created by those faithful to her using basic materials such as wood
